title: Narada Vijaya
desc: Narada, a celestial being, is forced to descend to Earth and interact with humans. However, complications arise when he is mistaken for Vijay, a police officer.

title: Kaaneyadavara Bagge Prakatane
desc: Three childhood friends in their 60s take a trip to Bangkok along with a guide. However, their holiday turns complicated when a local police officer, Yashwant, links them to an ongoing murder case.

title: Paagal
desc: After losing his mother at a young age, Prem looks for love in every woman he meets. However, when true love knocks on his door, it comes with its own set of challenges.

title: Shakti: The Power
desc: Nandini and Shekhar's visit to India turns tragic when they meet his violent family. After losing Shekhar, Nandini fights to save their son and escape back home.

title: Bagheera
desc: In a lawless land plagued by injustice and corruption, a police officer becomes a vigilante, protecting the innocent and punishing the guilty.

title: Mugulu Nage
desc: Pulakeshi is romantically involved with three women at different points in his life, which teaches him the meaning of love.
